name: @bighatpoland/ui

tokens.note: Product code and generated code may reference semantic tokens only. Primitives exist to define semantics and are not part of the public API.

contrast.enforcedBy: src/tokens/contrast.test.ts — runs in CI, fails the build

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Disclosure of one topic at a time. Headers are real buttons inside headings.
notFor: Navigation between screens
Hiding content the user always needs

headingLevel.note: Where the accordion sits in the document outline.

AccordionItem.meta.note: Count or status next to the title.

components.name: AppBar
components.purpose: The top bar. Three slots in reading order: brand, title, actions.
notFor: Repeating the product name in title — brand already carries it

title.note: Names the current screen, not the product.

titleAsHeading.note: false when the screen has its own visible <h1>.

center.note: Search or filters acting on this screen.

components.name: AppShell
components.purpose: The frame every application screen sits in. Owns the landmark structure — header, nav, main, complementary.
notFor: Documentation and marketing pages — use height="flow" or no shell at all

rail.note: Narrow icon rail on the leading edge.

height.meaning: fill pins to the viewport and scrolls each region independently

components.note: Slots are optional. A screen without a rail is this component with a prop left out, not a second layout.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: A person, as a picture with a name behind it.
notFor: A logo
Carrying status on its own

name.note: Initials and accessible name come from it.

decorative.note: True when the name is already visible next to it.

components.name: Badge
components.purpose: Short status attached to an object.
notFor: Bare counts
Anything clickable

dot.note: Decorative. The label still carries the meaning.

children.note: Required by design — colour alone fails WCAG 1.4.1.

components.name: Board
components.purpose: Columns of cards — kanban, pipeline, review queue.
notFor: Ordered data the user compares — that is Table

Board.announcement.note: Spoken by the board's live region after a move.

BoardColumn.empty.note: Use a StateBlock with copy specific to the column.

BoardCard.onMove.note: Required for a pointer-free move — WCAG 2.5.1.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Position in a hierarchy. The last crumb is the current page and is not a link.
notFor: Click history
A two-level hierarchy — a back link is enough

maxItems.note: Beyond this the middle collapses; root and leaf always show.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: An action the user takes.
notFor: Navigation — use an anchor styled as a link

variant=\"danger\".reason: variant conflated visual weight with consequence

components.name: Card
components.purpose: A bounded surface around content the user might act on as a unit.
notFor: A paragraph — that is a border with extra steps
Cards with two actions inside

onClick.note: Makes the whole surface one button.

ariaLabel.note: Its accessible name when onClick is set.

accent.note: Decorative — never the only carrier of a status.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: An independent yes/no that is submitted with a form.
notFor: An immediate setting — that is Switch
Mutually exclusive options — that is RadioGroup

error.note: Its presence is the invalid state.

indeterminate.note: Set as a DOM property, so it announces as mixed.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: A text field that filters a list. The one custom listbox in the system.
notFor: A short, fixed set — use Select
Free text — the value must come from the list
components.note: Escape closes the list; a second Escape clears the field. Blur restores the committed value.

components.name: Composer
components.purpose: The prompt input — a textarea in a form, with optional single-choice modes.
notFor: Ordinary multi-line form fields

modes.note: Rendered as a radio group, not buttons.

hint.note: The place for an accuracy notice.

components.note: Enter submits, Shift+Enter adds a line — and the form still submits the ordinary way, so switch access and voice control work without knowing the key handler.

components.name: DatePicker
components.purpose: A native date input, with the format and range stated in the description.
notFor: A custom calendar grid
A duration — that is two fields

components.name: Dialog
components.purpose: A decision that must block the rest of the page. Native <dialog>.
notFor: Non-blocking feedback — use Toast

dismissible.note: false blocks Escape and backdrop click. Destructive confirmations only.

components.name: Divider
components.purpose: A line between things. Decorative unless it carries a label.
notFor: Spacing — use the gap tokens

children.note: Turns it into a labelled role=separator.

components.name: IconPicker
components.purpose: Choosing one icon from a searchable grid. A radio group, not a wall of buttons.
notFor: An icon set with no names — the name is the accessible label

icons.note: Each needs a name; keywords widen the search.

components.name: Input
components.purpose: Single-line text entry with label, description and error wired to ARIA.
notFor: Controls with their own keyboard model — date pickers, comboboxes

hideLabel.note: Hides visually, keeps it for assistive tech.

error.note: Its presence is what sets aria-invalid.

components.name: List
components.purpose: A vertical list of records: leading media, title, supporting line, trailing slot.
notFor: Data the user compares or sorts — that is Table
A selectable master pane — that is ListView

ListItem.href.note: Makes the row a link. Mutually exclusive with onSelect.

ListItem.trailing.note: Rendered outside the row's own control.

components.name: ListView
components.purpose: A selectable master list driving a detail pane. One tab stop, arrows, type-ahead.
notFor: Multi-select — that is a Table with a checkbox column
Static records — that is List

empty.note: Use StateBlock for anything richer than a line.

components.name: Menu
components.purpose: A list of actions behind a trigger. Focus moves in on open and back on close.
notFor: Navigation — those are links
Choosing a value — that is Select

renderTrigger.note: For an icon button or an avatar trigger.

components.name: NavList
components.purpose: Grouped list inside a side panel — saved views, recent items, a shallow tree.
notFor: Tabular data — use Table
components.note: A real <ul>, so a screen reader announces the item count before the user commits to reading it.

components.name: NavRail
components.purpose: Narrow icon navigation rail.
notFor: Destinations whose meaning needs more than two words

showLabels.note: Prefer it past about five destinations.

components.note: NavRailItem.label is required — it is the accessible name, the tooltip and the optional caption. An icon-only rail without it is a memory test.

components.name: Progress
components.purpose: How far along something is. Determinate or honestly indeterminate.
notFor: A fake bar that waits at 90%
A skeleton's job — an unknown layout

components.name: RadioGroup
components.purpose: One choice out of a visible, mutually exclusive set. The group is the component.
notFor: More than about six options — that is Select or Combobox
Independent toggles — that is Checkbox

components.name: ScrollArea
components.purpose: A scrollable region that is reachable by keyboard and keeps the platform scrollbar.
notFor: Replacing the scrollbar with divs
A region that never overflows

ariaLabel.note: Used once the region becomes focusable.

components.note: tabIndex is added only while the content actually overflows.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.purpose: Two to five mutually exclusive options, all visible. A radio group that looks like buttons.
notFor: More than five options
A filter with a cleared state

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Choosing one value from a short, known list. Native element underneath.
notFor: Search
Multi-select
Async or very long option lists

options.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }>

placeholder.note: Rendered as a disabled first option.

components.name: SidePanel
components.purpose: A persistent panel beside the main content.
notFor: Anything blocking — use Dialog
Transient drawers
components.note: Never traps focus and never makes the page inert — the user works in main and reads the panel at the same time.

components.name: Skeleton
components.purpose: A placeholder for content whose shape is already known.
notFor: Waits with no known shape — use StateBlock state="loading"
components.usage: Wrap bones in <SkeletonGroup label="Loading documents">; the group makes the single announcement.

animated.note: Shimmer is off under prefers-reduced-motion regardless.

components.note: Individual bones are aria-hidden; the group announces once. Otherwise a screen reader reads "blank" forty times.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: A native range input for an approximate value on a continuum.
notFor: A value the user needs to type exactly — that is Input
Fewer than about ten steps

components.name: StateBlock
components.purpose: The empty, loading and error surfaces of any data view.
notFor: The happy path

title.note: One line, sentence case, no trailing period.

description.note: Say what the user can do, not what the server did.

action.note: The single most useful next step. Omit rather than invent.

diagnostics.note: Error only. Rendered inside a collapsed <details>.

announcements.error: role=alert — assertive, the user's action failed
announcements.empty: no live region — a successful response with nothing in it

components.name: StatusBar
components.purpose: The thin bar at the bottom of an application. Its message slot is a polite live region.
notFor: Anything urgent — that is Toast
Actions — that is Toolbar

items.note: Label and value pairs, read out together.

message.note: Announced politely. Always rendered so the region exists before it fills.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: An immediate setting. Takes effect on click, with no Save button.
notFor: A value submitted with a form — that is Checkbox
components.note: role=switch, so the state announces as on/off rather than checked.

components.name: Table
components.purpose: Comparable rows of structured data.
notFor: Layout

caption.note: Names the table for assistive tech.

sort.note: Controlled — the same component works with server-side sorting.

state.note: Replaces the body with a StateBlock across every column.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: A filter over one screen. Roving tabindex, arrows to move, panel is the next tab stop.
notFor: Content with its own URL — those are links
More tabs than fit without scrolling

defaultTab.note: Defaults to the first tab registered.

manual.note: Arrows move focus; Enter or Space activates. Use for expensive panels.

components.name: Toast
components.purpose: Ephemeral confirmation that something happened.
notFor: Errors the user must act on in place — use StateBlock
components.usage: Wrap the app in <ToastProvider>, then call useToast().notify(...).

tone.note: critical routes to the assertive live region and never auto-dismisses.

components.name: Toolbar
components.purpose: A row of controls acting on the content below it. One tab stop, arrows between controls.
notFor: Page-level navigation — that is AppBar
A single button

ariaLabel.note: Names what the toolbar acts on.

end.note: Trailing slot: search, view switches, counts.

components.name: Tooltip
components.purpose: A short label for a control that has none. Dismissible, hoverable, persistent.
notFor: Anything interactive inside it — that is a popover
Text the user must read to succeed

delay.note: Hover only. Focus shows it immediately.

components.note: Describes the trigger via aria-describedby; it never becomes its accessible name.

components.name: UserProfile
components.purpose: Who is signed in, and the account actions. Name as text, not only as initials.
notFor: Showing another person — that is Avatar
App navigation

secondary.note: E-mail or tenant — what tells two accounts apart.

items.note: Sign out last. Without them it renders as static identity.

compact.note: Hides the text; the button then names the account itself.

rules: Never reference a primitive token from product code.
Never use a spacing value outside the 4px scale.
Never write a bespoke empty, loading or error state — use StateBlock.
Never let colour be the only carrier of meaning.
Never remove a focus outline; add className="bh-focusable" instead.
Never use a placeholder in place of a label.
Prefer a new component over a new prop on an existing one.
Never rebuild the application frame out of divs — AppShell carries the named landmarks.
Never ship a drag-only interaction; BoardCard.onMove is the pointer-free path (WCAG 2.5.1).
Never use a Skeleton for a wait whose shape is unknown — it promises a layout that never arrives.
Never leave a SidePanel or NavRail without an ariaLabel.
Never use role="toolbar", "tablist" or "listbox" without the arrow-key handling they promise — Toolbar, Tabs and ListView already implement it.
Never put an interactive element inside a Tooltip; a tooltip the user has to reach is a popover.
Never use a Switch for a value that is submitted with a form, or a Checkbox for one that takes effect immediately.
Never let a Combobox commit free text — the value must come from the list.
Never build a scrollable region without a keyboard path to it; ScrollArea adds the tab stop only while it overflows.

templates.note: Templates are documented in Storybook and deliberately not exported. Copy them into the product and edit.
